name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.announce.SettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from an announcement conversation's settings entry. It shows announcement server settings and lets users copy its sharing information, change the icon or emoji access, edit its name or topic, manage members and managers, and leave or dismiss the server.
disableEffect: Users lose the built-in controls for managing announcement settings and for leaving or dismissing the announcement server.
